verdict_reason: Q663885 is Beyond Gravity (formerly RUAG Space), the Swiss aerospace group (country Switzerland, seat Zurich-area item Q72). IN-0527 is Beyond Gravity Austria GmbH, a Vienna limited liability company that is a subsidiary of Beyond Gravity Sweden AB, not the group parent.
